name: SINTRAN K
description: SINTRAN III/VSE version K, standard ND-100 system disk

name: SINTRAN L for the ND-5000
description: SINTRAN III VSX/500 version L (generated 16 December 1988) system disc prepared for the ND-5000 machine - the pack the built-in ND-5000 boots; SYSTEM logs in with no password. First version.

name: SINTRAN with COSMOS (BIGDISK)
description: SINTRAN III SMD system disc with COSMOS over Ethernet and HDLC. What the COSMOS machine boots.

name: Clean 75 MB Disk
description: Empty 75 MB SMD disk image, for installing an OS from floppy

name: BSD 2.11 Winchester
description: 2.11BSD for the ND-100 (the bsd211_481 port), on an ST506/8 inch Winchester image (cards 3041/3038, IOX 500-507). What the BSD 2.11 machine boots.

name: SINTRAN M with TCP/IP
description: SINTRAN III version M with TCP/IP on an ST506/8 inch Winchester image; its AIP files give the ND 192.168.210.40 (docs/ETHERNET.md). What the TCP/IP machine boots.

name: SCSI test disk
description: ND-3201/3204 SCSI test image (hdd), for the SCSI tab.

name: SINTRAN floppy
description: 8 inch floppy image as shipped with the emulator

name: NDIX root disk
description: NDIX-C root filesystem for a standalone ND-500 machine (Machine Setup > New > ND-500 standalone). Boots straight off this disc; the kernel is its own /vmunix.

name: NORD TSS 3.0 cartridge disc
description: NORD Time Sharing System 3.0 (1973) on a CDC 9427 cartridge disc: the TSS repo's jump-start disc (bootstrap, formatted, cold-started, user SYSTEM) padded to 4 MB. Booted with the disc's LOAD button on an MMS1 machine with a swapping drum.
